title: Default Go HTTP server without timeouts (go)
description: Go code starts a server with http.ListenAndServe. The package-level function uses a default http.Server with no read, write, or header timeouts, so slow clients can hold connections open indefinitely. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer switches to an http.Server with ReadHeaderTimeout and ReadTimeout set.
remediation: Create an http.Server with ReadHeaderTimeout, ReadTimeout, WriteTimeout, and IdleTimeout set, then call its ListenAndServe method.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the package-level call. A server configured on a separate line is not recognised.
